description: This file is a shell test script for Git's large object promisor remote capabilities. It sets up repositories, configures promisor settings, clones repositories with various promisor options, and verifies behaviors related to promisor remote advertisement, acceptfromserver, and fetch operations, including testing the transmission of fields, missing objects, and reinitialization scenarios.

methods.name: check_missing_objects
methods.description: Checks for missing objects in a repository, verifying a specific number of missing objects and optionally comparing against expected OIDs.

methods.name: initialize_server
methods.description: Reprepares the server repository, repacking objects, removing promisor files, creating promisor packs, and verifying missing objects.

methods.name: copy_to_lop
methods.description: Copies an object from the server repository to the LOP (Large Object Promisor) repository directory.
